Advisory service

Business Risk Assessment

Insurance works best when it follows a clear view of your risks. A business risk assessment walks through your operations, assets, people and contracts to identify what can go wrong, how badly, and what to do about it.

What we do

  • Map your operations, premises, people and contracts
  • Identify exposures to property, liability, people, transit and cyber risks
  • Suggest practical risk controls alongside insurance options
  • Prioritise what to insure, what to retain and what to fix
  • Prepare a clear summary you can share with partners or lenders

How it works

  1. Intake

    You complete a short form and send basic documents.

  2. Conversation

    We talk through how the business really runs.

  3. Findings

    We summarise risks, gaps and options in plain language.

  4. Action plan

    You choose what to act on, with our help if you want it.

What to have ready

  • A short description of your business and locations
  • Asset and stock summary
  • Employee numbers and roles
  • Existing policies, if any

Please note

  • A risk assessment is advisory. It is not an engineering survey or a legal opinion.
  • Insurer terms and availability apply to any cover that follows.

Questions

Is this only for large companies?

No. Small businesses often benefit most because a single loss can hurt more.
